description: Read one stored official TED award notice by publication number. Use awards_list_contracts to discover notices or filter by company; this accepts only a known notice_id. Returns award (winners, buyer, value, CPV, dates, lots, notice URL and SHA-256 proof) and feed coverage/check time. Missing notices return award_not_found; a missing feed returns awards_feed_not_ready. This reads stored observations, not a live TED lookup. Free keyless allowance: 10 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.
name: awards_get_contract
title: Get one EU contract award
